# NeetBand — Audio Learning for NEET Aspirants

> NeetBand is an educational auditory learning platform created specifically for NEET (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test) aspirants in India (Class 11 & 12). It translates dense NCERT textbooks into high-retention audio tracks, songs, audio summaries, and quizzes.

## Core Capabilities & Features

- **Audio-First Science Learning**: Music-based memory mnemonics for Class 11 & 12 Biology, Chemistry, and Physics.
- **Eye Health & Screen Reduction**: Designed to reduce visual strain and eye fatigue by allowing students to study hands-free and screen-free.
- **Full NEET Syllabus Alignment**: Aligned with the official NTA NCERT NEET UG curriculum.
- **Interactive Quizzes & Practice**: Q&A, active recall modules, and syllabus tracking.
- **PWA & Offline Access**: Progressive Web App capabilities allowing students to download tracks and listen anywhere without internet connection.

## Key Subject Coverage

- **Biology**: Cell Biology, Plant Physiology, Human Physiology, Genetics & Evolution, Biotechnology, Ecology.
- **Chemistry**: Physical Chemistry formulas, Organic Chemistry reaction mechanisms, Inorganic Chemistry memory tracks.
- **Physics**: Core formulas, definitions, laws of motion, electrodynamics, optics mnemonics.

## Target Audience
Class 11, Class 12, and repeater NEET aspirants seeking high-retention revision methods while minimizing eye strain.
